about.h1Second: and for over 8 years, I've had the honor of documenting more than 248 wedding stories across Europe, framing the quiet, honest moments that define our lives.
intro: When I’m not documenting weddings, you’ll most likely find me in the mountains. This love for wild, quiet places is where my search for honest light begins. It is why you see peaks and clouds on these pages—they are my greatest teachers of patience and perspective.

My work is a search for honesty. I believe that the most powerful imagery comes from a place of quiet observation rather than forced poses. Based in Prague, I travel across Europe to document stories that are as raw as they are refined.
Whether it's the grandeur of a historic museum or a quiet morning in the mountains, I am constantly looking for the light that reveals the soul of the moment.

At the end of the day, my goal is simple: to create images that don’t just show what your wedding looked like, but remind you how it felt. I avoid passing trends to focus on what’s real. I want you to look at your photos twenty years from now and see your true selves, captured in the most beautiful light possible.
about.quote: "I find the beauty in the unseen, the quiet, and the timeless."
beyond: Exploring the wild landscapes of the Alps or the Dolomites is where I truly recharge. It's the same patience required for a long hike that I bring to my photography—waiting for the perfect light, respecting the environment, and staying present in every second.

For me, the mountains are the ultimate teachers. They show you that you cannot rush greatness and that the most beautiful moments often require the most effort to reach. This discipline allows me to remain calm and focused amidst the beautiful chaos of a wedding day.

Whether I’m navigating a rocky ridge or the historic streets of a European city, my curiosity remains the same. I am constantly seeking new perspectives and untold stories. It’s not just about the destination; it’s about the soul of the journey.

Ultimately, this passion for discovery is what keeps my work fresh and honest. I am always ready to pack my bags and travel wherever your story takes us, bringing a piece of that mountain stillness with me.
reviews: "Exceeding expectations is always the goal. A beautiful note from Ekaterina about our timing and the soul behind every shot. So grateful for couples like this"
"When a family story becomes addictive. Ruslana and her family watched it on loop several times before even hitting the download button. Truly touched by these words"
"A moment of transformation for Ruslana. 'I don't even recognize myself' is the ultimate compliment for a boudoir story. Truly a chic and honest set"
"Editorial magic with Victoria. Her reaction — 'No one has ever seen me like this before' — is the ultimate goal when we create a high-end, magazine-style story together"

"It's all about the 'eye for the frame'. Anna’s wedding was a joy to document, and I’m honored she felt the soul of her important day reflected in these shots. Looking forward to our next chapters together"
"Happy tears from Margarita. It’s all about catching that one fleeting moment — like the roses she mentioned. Seeing her reaction makes every second of the 'hunt' for the perfect shot worth it"
"The ultimate compliment is a returning client. After her wedding, Margarita came back for an editorial session. Her reaction — 'I have no words' — says it all. It’s a joy to see her energy again"

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Denys Stepaniuk Photography handles your personal data.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: This website is the portfolio of Denys Stepaniuk, a wedding and editorial photographer, who is responsible for the personal data described here.

sections.heading: Information you share
sections.body: When you write to me through the contact form, I receive your name, email address and message. I use them only to reply to your enquiry and to discuss your photography, and I never sell or share them for marketing.

sections.heading: Analytics
sections.body: Only if you accept, anonymous usage data is collected through Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity: pages viewed, device and browser type, approximate location and how the site is navigated. This helps me understand how the site is used and to refine your experience. If you decline, neither service is loaded.

sections.heading: Legal basis
sections.body: Replying to enquiries rests on your request and on legitimate interest. Analytics rest on your consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)), which you may withdraw at any time without affecting earlier processing.

sections.heading: Third parties and transfers
sections.body: Messages from the contact form are delivered to my email by the Web3Forms service. Google and Microsoft act as service providers for analytics. Data may be processed outside the European Economic Area under the safeguards those providers maintain, such as standard contractual clauses.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Enquiries are kept for as long as needed to respond and to manage any resulting booking, then deleted. Analytics data is retained according to the settings of each provider.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability of your data, and object to its processing. You may also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority. To exercise any right, please use the contact form available on the Contact page.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: Which cookies this website uses and how to control them.

sections.heading: Essential storage
sections.body: Your choice is saved in your browser's local storage under the key “cookie-consent”. It is strictly necessary to remember your decision and contains no personal information.

sections.heading: Analytics cookies
sections.body: Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity use cookies to measure traffic and to understand how visitors move through the site. They are loaded only after you press Accept; if you decline, they are never loaded and no analytics cookies are set.

sections.heading: Changing your mind
sections.body: You may accept or decline analytics cookies at any time using the button below. Declining after accepting stops further data collection; you can also clear existing cookies in your browser settings.
